title: Yeast Genomic DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Joseph Ong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bptbmnin

steps.title: Initial Yeast Culture
steps.instruction: Streak yeast from glycerol stock onto YPD and grow at 30 °C for two or three overnights until visible colonies form.

steps.title: Overnight Colony Expansion
steps.instruction: Grow 3 separate colonies in 40 mL of YPD (50 g Difco™ YPD dissolved in 1 L of DI water and autoclaved at 120 °C for 15 minutes) in a 50 mL conical tube at 30°C overnight (~17 hrs) with shaking at 250 rpm.

steps.title: Harvest Yeast Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the overnight culture at 4,000 rpm for 5 minutes to pellet the yeast and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Spheroplast Preparation
steps.instruction: Treat the yeast pellet with Zymolyase to remove the cell wall.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend yeast pellet in 3 mL of 0.9 M sorbitol and 0.1 M Na 2 EDTA (pH 7.5).
Add 0.1 mL of 2.5 mg/mL (resuspended in 0.9 M sorbitol) solution of Zymolyase 100T (Sigma).
Incubate for one hour at 37 °C with gentle shaking.
Centrifuge at 4,000 rpm for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells using SDS and heat.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in 5 mL of 50 mM Tris-Cl and 20 mM Na 2 EDTA (pH 7.4).
Add 0.5 mL of 10% (w/v) SDS, stirring carefully and thoroughly to avoid bubbles.
Incubate in a 65 °C water bath for 30 minutes, gently swirling the tube at the 15-minute mark.
Add 1.5 mL of 5 M potassium acetate and mix thoroughly by gentle inversion.
Leave on ice for 1 hour, mixing via gentle inversion every 15 minutes.
Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm in a Sorvoll SS-34 rotor for 10 minutes to yield a thick, wide pellet.

steps.title: Initial DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA from the supernatant using ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant into a clean Oak Ridge tube and add two volumes (about 10 mL) of absolute ethanol.
Centrifuge at 5,500 rpm for 15 minutes and discard supernatant.
Invert the uncapped Oak Ridge tube to allow the pellet to air-dry for about ten minutes.

steps.title: DNA Resuspension and Cleaning
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA and remove cellular debris.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet by gentle mixing in 3 mL of TE buffer (10 mM Tris-Cl, 1 mM Na 2 EDTA, pH 7.4).
Transfer the solution into two 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm at 4 °C for 10 minutes in a tabletop centrifuge to yield a small pale white or pale white-yellow pellet.
Combine the supernatant from both tubes back into one 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: RNA Removal
steps.instruction: Treat the DNA solution with RNAse A to remove RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 7.5 µL of RNAse A (20 mg/mL from Sigma) and mix gently.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Secondary DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform a second precipitation to further purify the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add two volumes (about 6 mL) of absolute ethanol into the 15 mL conical tube and gently mix by inversion to yield a loose “cobweb” of DNA.
Pellet the DNA by centrifugation at 4,500 rpm at 4 °C in a tabletop centrifuge and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Final DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Wash and resuspend the purified genomic DNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend DNA pellet in 200 µL of DI water and transfer to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add two volumes (400 µL) of absolute ethanol and gently mix by inversion.
Centrifuge at 5k rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C in a tabletop centrifuge.
Remove supernatant by careful pipetting.
Invert tube and leave uncapped for 15 minutes to allow remaining ethanol to air-dry.
Resuspend purified DNA in 50 µL of DI water.

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Verify the DNA and store for future use.

substeps.instruction: Assess purity and integrity of the genomic DNA via Nanodrop and TE-agarose gel electrophoresis.
Store DNA in freezer (-20°C) until sequencing.
